name: churn-risk-gbm
description: Scores active subscribers each Monday with the probability of cancelling within the next 60 days. Customers above the threshold are offered a retention call.

primary_uses: Prioritising weekly retention calls for consumer subscribers
out_of_scope: Business customers (not in the training data)

training_data.label_definition: cancelled within 60 days after the snapshot date

threshold.rationale: the call team handles about 39% of flagged customers per week

fairness.assessment: Recall is lower for group B; see the table and the mitigation below.

limitations: Customers with under 2 months of tenure have few signals; scores are close to the base rate
Age band 'unknown' has too few rows to evaluate

risks.risk: Group B customers are under-served by retention offers
risks.mitigation: Group-specific threshold under review; monthly recall report by group

ethical_considerations: Scores influence who receives retention offers: lower recall for group B means fewer offers to that group
No protected attributes are model inputs; zip-code-derived features were removed as potential proxies
explainability: Global drivers from permutation importance and SHAP: tenure, support calls, days since last login. Per-customer reason codes use SHAP with a fixed background of 500 retained customers.
